summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing an ordinary share buyback transaction. On 1 June 2026, the company purchased 10,000,000 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International at a volume-weighted average price of 100.1386 pence per share, with prices ranging from 99.2600 to 101.4000 pence. These purchases are part of an existing buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026. The shares will be cancelled. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or structural complexity is involved. This is a routine capital return execution, not a special situation. What to watch: continued buyback pace within the existing programme.
